facts.fact: 本章开篇三连词顺序为 Walkers. Watchers. Witches.，与 ch12 日记里的 Witches. Watchers. Walkers. 顺序相反
facts.anchor: There are walkers on these moors. Walkers. Watchers. Witches.

facts.fact: 雾中人影显形为约 19-20 岁女孩，穿派克大衣与步行靴
facts.anchor: The ghostly figure resolved itself into the figure of a girl, aged maybe nineteen or twenty, wearing a parka and walking boots.

facts.fact: 男主盘问女孩为何出现在私人土地上
女孩说他们都认识 Kirkhill，但并非住在这栋屋里
女孩解释 pylon 一词源自希腊语，意为门或入口
facts.anchor: Pylon comes from the Greek, you know. It means a gate or doorway.

facts.fact: 搜救队发现 Kirkhill 原主人手牵手躺在距屋百码外的雪中
facts.anchor: A search party found them, hand in hand, a hundred yards away from the house.

facts.fact: 女孩说 Kirkhill 原名 Firefleet，源自一首歌
男主最终告诉女孩可以叫他 Arthur
